consequence.statement: Existing ServiceMonitor resources continue to function; the new optional field allows explicit control over service discovery role when needed.

assertion.statement: ServiceMonitor v1 schema adds optional field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole to explicitly set the service discovery role (Endpoints or EndpointSlice) for target discovery, defaulting to the value in the referenced Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource if unset.
